digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI workflows
propositions: External integration suite currently tests only one live provider (Anthropic) despite supporting three credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving provider-specific regressions undetectable by CI
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows with each arm selecting via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE overlay setting [llm.model_classes], not via deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL
Bedrock arm must obtain credentials via OIDC role assumption to a scoped IAM role on GitHub-hosted runners, not via EC2 instance role (S7 pattern) or static API keys
Each CI arm must fail loudly when credentials are absent rather than skip silently, making credential absence visible and distinguishable from successful execution
Bedrock arm must explicitly resolve AWS region by setting both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION as job environment variables to prevent NoRegionError
Config overlays must not leave ambient default model paths (cfg.model) calling the default Anthropic provider, verified by test assertions on both class table and ambient default resolution
